about.title: Bayan ng Mananalo
summary: In the early 17th century, Pablo and Rita settled in what is now Pagbilao, bringing rice seedlings and provisions.
According to local tradition, Spanish missionaries arrived in 1725 and the name Pagbilao came from papag and bilao.
